title: An explainable machine learning model for predicting bladder tumor aecurrence risk.
summary: Retrospective cohort of 504 histologically confirmed NMIBC cases, with recurrence established by cystoscopy/histopathology; LASSO plus comparison of 11 ML algorithms selected seven-feature XGBoost, independent testing AUC .994. Single-center retrospective evaluation; external validation absent.
